text:
Predicates:
City(x) ::: x is a city.
In(x, y) ::: x is in y.
State(x) ::: x is a state.
Premises:
City(billings) ∧ In(billings, montana) ::: Billings is a city in Montana.
State(montana) ::: Montana includes the cities of Butte, Helena, and Missoula.
City(butte) ∧ City(helena) ∧ City(missoula) ∧ In(butte, montana) ∧ In(helena, montana) ∧ In(missoula, montana) ::: Montana includes the cities of Butte, Helena, and Missoula.
City(whiteSulphurSprings) ∧ City(butte) ∧ In(whiteSulphurSprings, montana) ∧ In(butte, montana) ::: White Sulphur Springs and Butte are cities in the same state.
City(pierre) ∧ ¬In(pierre, montana) ::: The city of Pierre is not in Montana.
∀x ∀y (City(x) ∧ City(y) ∧ In(x, y) → ¬In(x, pierre)) ::: Any city in Butte is not in Pierre.
Conclusion:
In(missoula, montana) ::: Montana is home to the city of Missoula.
